item.title: Natural England and Environment Agency could be abolished
item.body: Louise Haigh announced plans to reform quangos, or quasi-autonomous non-governmental organisations, in a speech to the CBI. Natural England and the Environment Agency could be abolished as part of a quango cull.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🏛️ Natural England and Environment Agency could be abolished

Louise Haigh announced plans to reform quangos, or quasi-autonomous non-governmental organisations, in a speech to the CBI. Natural England and the Environment Agency could be abolished as part of a quango cull.

Source: The Independent | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 23 November, 14:20
